sections.text: No person may produce a standard remote identification unmanned aircraft under § 89.510 or § 89.515 or a remote identification broadcast module under § 89.520, unless the producer assigns to the unmanned aircraft or remote identification broadcast module a serial number that complies with ANSI/CTA-2063-A. ANSI/CTA-2063-A, Small Unmanned Aerial Systems Serial Numbers (September 2019) is incorporated by reference into this section with the approval of the Director of the Office of the Federal Register under 5 U.S.C. 552(a) and 1 CFR part 51. All approved material is available for inspection at the FAA's Office of Rulemaking (ARM-1), [REDACTED STREET_ADDRESS], Washington, DC 20590 (telephone [REDACTED PHONE]) and is available from Consumer Technology Association (CTA), [REDACTED STREET_ADDRESS], Arlington, VA 22202, [REDACTED EMAIL] , [REDACTED PHONE] or at https://www.cta.tech. It is also available for inspection at the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA). For information on the availability of this material at NARA, email [REDACTED EMAIL], or go to www.archives.gov/federal-register/cfr/ibr-locations.html.
